review_methodology_notes: Independent review performed by Claude (Anthropic), a model distinct from and with no role in producing the runtime answers under review (gemini-flash-lite-latest). Review is based solely on the supplied semantic-review-packet-v11.json contents (case reference_assertions, observations, and trace), per the reviewer prompt's instruction to not infer evidence beyond the packet. Two systemic packet limitations affect every case and are documented per-case where relevant: (1) trace.final_output_redacted is hard-truncated to ~600-601 characters for all 26 cases, frequently cutting off before the answer reaches its concluding recommendation or final required criterion; (2) the packet does not include the original verbatim user prompt/conversation, only a short source_reference paraphrase, which limits confident judgment of topical relevance for some cases. Decisions follow the packet's own derivation rule (PASS requires all 5 dimensions >=3; any dimension <=1 forces FAIL; otherwise REVIEW_REQUIRED) and the groundedness guard (score >=3 requires literal deterministic source-identity match per the packet's own expected_sources, consistent with independent_semantic_evaluator.py's validate_review_payload).
